description: Scans this computer read-only and reports which Replica Crew target types it can build today (web, desktop, android, game, mashup) and what is missing for the rest: OS, CPU count, and the toolchains found (Node, Python, Java, Flutter, Android SDK, .NET, Rust, Go, Godot, Blender, Docker, Playwright, adb). Run first, before scope, so the plan only promises what the machine can actually do. Use when the user says "what can I build", "check my computer", "will this run here", "am I set up for Android / games / desktop", "replica doctor", or at the start of any clone whose target is not plain web.
